subject.title: Multi-profile profile targeting/config truth is ambiguous with ~/.openclaw-* homes on macOS

question: What should the macOS profile-targeting contract be when an explicit root `--profile` conflicts with inherited LaunchAgent identity, profile casing, or separate profile homes?
rationale: The stale-label subcase is source-backed, but choosing how explicit profiles interact with custom launchd labels, case-sensitive profile names, and mixed layouts changes supported operator behavior.

options.title: Make explicit profile authoritative
options.body: Treat root `--profile` as the service, config, and session target; clear only stale OpenClaw-managed launchd labels and add clearer status output plus live proof.

options.title: Preserve label override precedence
options.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_LABEL` as the stronger targeting signal and document cross-profile lifecycle commands as unsupported unless the operator clears conflicting env state.

options.title: Defer broader profile design
options.body: Keep this as a product-design umbrella until maintainers decide casing, mixed-home, service-label, and status-truth semantics together.

recommendation.title: Make explicit profile authoritative
recommendation.body: Treat root `--profile` as the service, config, and session target; clear only stale OpenClaw-managed launchd labels and add clearer status output plus live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across CLI profile handling, launchd behavior, and the multi-gateway docs that define the product contract.
